providers.notes: Queries a hosted documentation service. The query text leaves the local machine; source code is not sent by the framework, but review the provider's own terms before enabling.

capabilities.description: A named provider is configured and its declared data_boundary matches the known provider class.
A quota-bearing external provider has an explicit non-negative cost cap; it is never inferred.
The configured MCP transport answers a resolve/query probe from the calling agent.
capabilities.verification_gap: EIF generates configuration for the agent to load; it does not itself speak MCP, so this capability is reported by the agent adapter, not probed by eifctl doctor.

capabilities.description: Project-local routing guidance tells the agent when a vendor-docs lookup outranks training-data recall, and when it does not apply.

authority_position.rule: Current vendor documentation is a normative source about intended behavior. It does not outrank an empirical observation of what the code actually does; a disagreement between them is a discrepancy to record, not a tie to break by rank.
